Ava (AE): Quick sync — Customer wants a POC that proves HSM-backed CMKs + dual-custodian rotation. They also flagged <https://compliance.example/reg-xyz|Reg-XYZ> as the baseline.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Got it. Do they need on-prem HSM or cloud HSM (CloudHSM/CloudKMS)?
Carlos (Customer-Infra): Prefer cloud HSM but must demonstrate M-of-N custody (2-of-3) and a rotation window of <=72h for emergency rotations.
Priya (Security): Also asked for tamper-evidence logs and attestation certificates (FIPS 140-2/3). We should confirm attestation cadence.
Maya (Pricing): Heads up: HSM-backed CMKs change the pricing model — reserved capacity vs per-request. I'll draft cost delta once we know throughput.
Ava (AE): For the POC they want 10k inference tokens/day, but peak bursts up to 500 req/s. Latency SLO is 200ms p50 for token generation.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Context: HSM round trips add ~10-40ms depending on region and proxy. We can cache DEKs (data-encryption keys) in the app layer and only use CMK for wrap/unwrap on rotation/cert events.
Carlos (Customer-Infra): Important: network egress to HSM endpoints must be routed through their transit gateway. Can we run a simulated CloudHSM endpoint in POC?
Jon (Solutions Eng): For POC we can either: 1) Use real CloudHSM instance in their AWS account (preferred) or 2) deploy a test harness that mocks KMS behavior + signed attestation logs. Option 1 needs cross-account networking and IAM role setup.
Ava (AE): Carlos — which option do you prefer?
Carlos (Customer-Infra): Option 1 but we need a minimal runbook and a firewall whitelist.
Priya (Security): We'll need to validate key ceremony: provide a script for 2-of-3 key-splitting and attestations. I'll review.
Jon (Solutions Eng): Sharing a quick example for the POC key unwrap flow (we'll paste this in the ticket):
```
# pseudo: wrap/unwrap flow for POC
# 1. App generates ephemeral DEK
# 2. DEK encrypted with CMK: wrap = kms.encrypt(KeyId=CMK, Plaintext=DEK)
# 3. App caches wrapped DEK + kv-cache TTL=4h
# 4. On rotation: new CMK created, rewrap DEKs in background job
```
Jon (Solutions Eng): We'll also provide acceptance tests: 1) live unwrap from CloudHSM 2) rotation with 2-of-3 custodians present 3) audit log contains attestations with cert thumbprints.
Maya (Pricing): For roughs, HSM provisioning + cross-account networking + SRE support adds a one-time $8k engineering setup + $1k/mo baseline HSM cost + per-usage fees. I'll record a conservative estimate in the SOW.
Ava (AE): Customer also asked security questionnaire Q12 about key ownership — they need a contractual CMK ownership clause and key export prohibition. Priya, can security draft that clause?
Priya (Security): Yes — we can provide standard CMK ownership language + export prohibition. Add a clause for emergency rotation runbook and custody attestation.
Carlos (Customer-Infra): One blocker: their legal wants a KMS rotation SLA (max time to rotate keys during incident). Can Redwood commit to 72h operations with runbook?
Jon (Solutions Eng): We can't rotate customer CMKs inside their HSM without their custodian triggering a ceremony. We can offer an assisted rotation workflow where Redwood engineers help coordinate and run scripts — that fits 72h but needs change freeze windows and access policies.
Ava (AE): Action items: @Jon share POC terraform + runbook, @Maya add pricing delta to SOW draft, @Priya draft contract clause and attestation template, @Carlos confirm AWS account and TGW CIDR.
Carlos (Customer-Infra): Confirm — AWS account will be ready by next Tue 10 AM PT.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: poc-hsm-harness -> staging at 2026-03-24T02:00Z (CI build #4822). :rocket:
Jon (Solutions Eng): I'll attach the terraform snippet in the follow-up thread and a sample test vector for unwrap.
Maya (Pricing): FYI — if they opt for simulated KMS instead of real HSM we can drop the one-time engineering fee by ~40%.
Priya (Security): One note: ensure audit logs are shipped to their splunk instance with signed checksums. We require immutable retention for 90 days for this POC.
Ava (AE): Thanks all — I'll loop in Legal and Ops on the SOW. Quick check: anyone foresee a hard blocker?
Carlos (Customer-Infra): Main risk is transit gateway firewall rules timing. We'll prioritize that.
Jon (Solutions Eng): No technical blockers from our side; need account access and attestation files.
Priya (Security): No blockers — will review clause by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (Pricing): I'll post SOW line items after lunch.
